entries.zh: 不在此；不在于此、与此无关
entries.en: it is not in this / that is not the point; it does not consist in that
entries.notes: 西语词头 consiste 拼写有疑，四栏互证『不在此』义清晰。

entries.zh: 不识；昧心（心不识、蒙昧无知）
entries.en: not to know (a person or thing); ignorant / ignorant-hearted
entries.notes: 汉字疑『昧/冐』两形，从『昧＝不识』定义。

entries.en: unseemly / improper; it is not fitting, not permissible
one may not / it is not permitted; it is not fitting

entries.zh: 相误；误了所托之事、彼此耽误（未能完成）
entries.en: to fail to carry out what is entrusted / to fall short of one's charge; to miss or delay one another
entries.notes: 西语词头 cayan 有疑读、汉字第三字四形难定，据『相误』与 no cumplir 定为误事、未完成所托。

entries.en: to not stop / to go on without ceasing
entries.notes: 西语第二词疑 citar/quitar/cullar，据汉字『不止』定为不停义。

entries.en: don't make a sound / keep quiet; don't make a noise
entries.notes: 西语 bozes 有疑读、闽南栏末字有疑读，『莫做声』义自明。

entries.en: don't shout / don't clamor
entries.notes: 汉字疑『嚷/囔』两形，义同莫出声。

entries.en: confused / mixed up, indistinguishable; in disorder
entries.notes: 汉栏仅单字『纷』、闽南栏末字有疑读，定为纷乱难辨义。

entries.zh: 遇不着；遇不到、找不到（人）
entries.en: not to find / not to run into (someone)
entries.notes: 闽南栏第二读首字有疑读，首读『遇不著』清晰。

entries.zh: 哄骗、戏弄；所言嘲弄不可解
entries.en: to mock / make game of; to fool with mocking words
entries.notes: 汉字疑『哄/哂/呸』三形、闽南栏有疑读，取『哄』与西语 haciendo burla 相合之义。

entries.en: neither friend nor enemy; not a friend nor an enemy
entries.notes: 汉字栏全行字迹难辨、闽南栏有疑读，中文释义无据；英文仅据可读的西语栏『非友非敌』给出。

entries.en: it is not necessary / need not; it does not matter
not necessary / need not

entries.zh: 免；不必、无须（免说、不必开口）
entries.en: not necessary / need not; there is no need to speak
entries.notes: 汉字疑有第二字未明，官话栏疑注 hablar（不必说），『免＝不必』义明确。

entries.en: no need / not necessary
not as good as / inferior to; not like, unlike
entries.notes: 西语词头缩残（疑为 como él），据『不如』定为不及、不像义。

entries.en: it is not permitted / one may not
improper / unseemly; not fitting
to have no mind to / unintentionally; without heart
entries.notes: 西语词头 está/hay 读法有疑，据汉字『无心』定无心义，官话栏『不在人』作旁证。
